# Liberation Sans Regular

Bundled here because the PAdES native engine renders visible signature text
by embedding this font subset into each signed PDF. Used by
`lib/libresign/src/native/pades_module.cpp`.

## Source

- Upstream: https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts
- Release: 2.1.5 (2023-01-10)
- Download: https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts/files/7261482/liberation-fonts-ttf-2.1.5.tar.gz
